resources.string: Report a connected DualSense as a native controller to compatible Apollo. Turn off for DualShock 4 compatibility; restart the game/stream after changing controller type.

Automatic pauses the extra controller audio/HD haptics on poor connections, high latency or stream bitrates below 12 Mbps. It resumes after 20 stable seconds. Requires the matching Apollo host. Buttons, ordinary rumble and adaptive triggers continue.
